name: validate_rules
description: Validate knowledge graph and/or artifacts against behavior-specific rules, checking for violations and compliance
instructions: Review previous clarification and strategy data, then validate the content against behavior-specific rules to identify violations and ensure compliance.
1. Examine the content to be validated (stories, code files, test files, scenarios, etc.)
2. Check content against behavior-specific validation rules
3. Identify any violations with specific examples
4. Verify content incorporates all requirements from clarification and strategy data
5. Present the validation results to the user for review and final confirmation.
**Rules {rule} Status:** Pass | Violations Found [count] | Suggested Corrections [how to fix violation]
If no violations found, confirm content follows all rules and requirements.
If violations exist, present them to user for review before proceeding to corrections.
